attrs.title: Top Topics
attrs.prompt:
You are an expert in agile retrospectives and project management.
Your team has just completed a meeting and it is your job to generate insights from the data and report to senior management.
Senior management wants to know where to best focus their time, so be concise and focus on next steps to take.
If there is not enough data to generate insightful findings, respond with "Not enough data to generate insights".
It should include at most 3 topics that are the most important highlights, takeaways, or areas that may need their attention.

content.text: Landing page testing works but needs tooling
: The team found a clear winner within a week and wants a real A/B framework. Scope one before the next campaign.
Attribution gaps hide what drives revenue
: Inconsistent campaign tags make reports hard to trust. A shared naming guide is the quickest fix.
: Specs and copy arrive separately. Trial a handoff template on the next feature.

content.text: Running three landing page variants at once and seeing a clear winner within a week
Shorter headlines beat long ones by 18 percent on sign-ups
A proper A/B test framework instead of swapping pages by hand
Write up the landing page test results and share them with the product team
The winning variant also had fewer form fields.
Consistent UTM naming so we can tell campaigns apart in reports
A single place to see which channel brought each paying customer
Specs and copy arriving together. Developers wait on the text.
A handoff template with specs, a copy deck and edge cases
Create a handoff template and trial it on the annual plan toggle
The October webinar had 340 registrations, double September
